values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753704 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a concrete boat ramp, a vault toilet and primitive campsites; 'Easy Accessibility'. Site is 2.53 acres.

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Missouri River at Craig with designated primitive camping (Region 4). Directions (FWP): East off Craig Exit 234 off I-15. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping (with/without fishing license), 38-ft trailer limit, 7-day stay limit (added to booking), vault toilet, concrete ramp, primitive campsites; open-all-year season (manual) unchanged.
